gate: SOCIAL (Phase 108 relationship / multi-party modeling, Track E2)
systemUnderTest: the directional relationship feature end-to-end (SOCIAL-01 sole adapter + offline builder + SOCIAL-02 per-channel/tenant/agent isolation + LLM-free injection + SOCIAL-03 sign-off gate + daemon wiring + the __SOCIAL_MODELING__ cron + keyless gate)

models.note: The model block records the INTENDED costed-pass configuration (the same answerer + cross-MODEL judge pair as the 2026-06-01-phase106-baser baseline). The KEYLESS run that backs this manifest calls NO model: the offline builder's build() seam is an INJECTED stub (a pure fn returning fixed DIRECTIONAL candidates), the multi-party fixtures are synthetic, and the injection path is the pure buildRelationshipBlock formatter. cross-PROVIDER judging with claude-opus-4-8 is the costed re-run — opus is used as a judge ONLY when the answer lane is non-Anthropic (an answerer must never be its own provider's judge).

measurementsTaken.name: directional round-trip (A->B != B->A)
measurementsTaken.result: PASS — a build returning A->B AND B->A upserts TWO distinct directional edges (never symmetrized/collapsed); the (tenant, agent, channel)-scoped read returns both, directionally intact. Mechanical, keyless, $0 — NOT a QA-accuracy lift.

measurementsTaken.name: (tenant, agent, channel) isolation (the per-channel privacy headline)
measurementsTaken.result: PASS — an edge written under scope A is structurally ABSENT across all foreign axes (cross-channel=0, cross-tenant=0, cross-agent=0) and PRESENT in-scope (=1). The per-channel + per-tenant + per-agent partition is enforced in SQL (every adapter statement filters tenant_id AND agent_id AND channel_id; the directional pair is row data, not the scope). Mechanical, keyless, $0 — NOT a QA-accuracy lift.

measurementsTaken.name: external REJECTED + redaction-clean (anti-poisoning)
measurementsTaken.result: PASS — a forged external-trust upsert is rejected at the write boundary (the high-trust floor + the DB CHECK), a builder run over an external-only source set writes 0 rows (the unconditional external-exclude runs BEFORE the build seam), and a secret-shaped candidate is flagged by validateMemoryWrite and SKIPPED (never down-stored — the relationship table has no external tier, the Pitfall-2 hardening). Mechanical, keyless, $0 — NOT a QA-accuracy lift.

measurementsTaken.name: the SOCIAL-03 sign-off gate (the read side)
measurementsTaken.result: PASS — with the knob on but NO recorded privacyReviewSignedOffBy the read+format injection gate is CLOSED: read() is called 0 times and no block is produced (the dual gate enabled && privacyReviewSignedOffBy && store is required). With enabled AND signed-off the gate opens, the read runs once, and the block renders. The cron + scheduler enforcement of the SAME dual gate is RED-proven in the daemon wiring tests (108-05). Mechanical, keyless, $0 — NOT a QA-accuracy lift.

measurementsTaken.name: default-OFF byte-identity (the cost gate)
measurementsTaken.result: PASS — with no edge rows the pure formatter returns null (nothing pushed -> byte-identical prompt); the <channel_relationships> block diverges ONLY when the store returns rows, and the read+format path makes 0 model/build calls (the recall hot path stays LLM-free). The no-regression-by-construction proof: with the feature off, the prompt is unchanged. Mechanical, keyless, $0 — NOT a QA-accuracy lift.

deferredToOperator.name: the human privacy-review SIGN-OFF + enabling the feature (the SOCIAL-03 operator gate)
deferredToOperator.why: SOCIAL-03 ships the capability + the three-site enforcement (cron + scheduler + read all gate on enabled && privacyReviewSignedOffBy) + the PRIVACY-REVIEW.md record, all DEFAULT-OFF. The actual sign-off decision — reviewing the privacy properties against the deployment's tenancy/channel model and recording privacyReviewSignedOffBy — is an OPERATOR decision. This run does NOT self-approve or self-enable: no committed config sets socialModeling.enabled or privacyReviewSignedOffBy (a grep for a string-valued privacyReviewSignedOffBy over non-test src is empty). Default-OFF byte-identity is preserved structurally (no config change ships).
deferredToOperator.reproductionNote: An operator reviews PRIVACY-REVIEW.md, then (if satisfied) records agents.<id>.socialModeling.privacyReviewSignedOffBy: "<reviewer>" + sets socialModeling.enabled: true. The __SOCIAL_MODELING__ cron then registers (default 0 6 * * *) and the offline builder populates per-channel directional edges; the <channel_relationships> read block activates. No secret value is recorded here — only the config field NAMES.

deferredToOperator.name: the costed multi-party Q&A accuracy lift (the costed QA delta)
deferredToOperator.why: Needs a real answer model (to answer grounded multi-party / relationship questions WITH vs WITHOUT the standing <channel_relationships> block), a real LLM judge (cross-judge >=2 per the credibility protocol), AND the offline builder run with a real cheap cron model (not the keyless stub seam) to populate edges from a real high-trust multi-party source set. All three cost real spend + keys. The keyless bench stubs the build seam and uses synthetic fixtures, so it proves the MECHANISM at $0 but produces no accuracy number; a fresh accuracy number here would be fabricated.
deferredToOperator.reproductionCommand: populate scripts/bench-memory.env (COMIS_BENCH + COMIS_BENCH_ANSWER_* + COMIS_BENCH_JUDGE_* variable NAMES), sign off + enable agents.<id>.socialModeling, run the __SOCIAL_MODELING__ cron with a real cron model, then run a grounded multi-party Q&A harness WITH vs WITHOUT the <channel_relationships> block under the answer model + two judges; record per-category accuracy delta + N + significance + cost + latency.
deferredToOperator.baselineToDiffAgainst: benchmarks/results/2026-06-01-phase106-baser/ (the v2.9 baseline the feature must not move when off)

coi.disclosure: Comis authored this benchmark harness. No competitor number, no cross-judged accuracy delta, and no comparative-ranking framing appears anywhere in this manifest. The relationship feature is measured only against itself (ON vs OFF mechanics) and the v2.9 baseline it must not move when off.
coi.ossLicense: Apache-2.0 harness — the keyless bench (relationship-contribution.bench.test.ts) carries an SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 header so the mechanical claims are independently reproducible at $0.
coi.rawTranscriptRelease: On the operator-costed re-run, the raw answer + judge transcripts for the multi-party Q&A lift are released alongside the dated row under benchmarks/results/history/<date>-<commit>.json so any accuracy number is auditable end-to-end.

honestyProtocol: Every number traces to a committed claim*-report.json, read back from disk before quoting. The five mechanical claims (directional round-trip, (tenant, agent, channel) isolation, external-reject + redaction-clean, the SOCIAL-03 sign-off gate, default-OFF byte-identity) are each labelled 'mechanical, keyless, $0 — NOT a QA-accuracy lift' and kept STRICTLY SEPARATE from BOTH the human privacy-review sign-off (the operator gate, DEFERRED — not self-approved) AND the costed multi-party Q&A accuracy lift (explicitly 'not measured — operator costed re-run', NOT a guessed delta). The keyless bench calls no answer model, no judge, no key, no provider (grep COMIS_BENCH_*_API_KEY over the bench returns 0). A post-run credential-shape sweep over the manifest is clean: it carries pure numbers + booleans + prose, no credential field names or secret-key/bearer-token shapes. This run ships DEFAULT-OFF (no committed config enables the feature).
